name: YouTube
layout_summary: Top header: YouTube logo on left, centered 'Search' input bar with magnifying glass button and voice search microphone icon, profile/notifications on right. On home/search: grid or vertical feed of video thumbnails and titles. On watch page: video player on left/center, title/channel/Subscribe/Like below player, Up Next recommendations on right.
avoid_traps: Do NOT click the microphone icon next to the search bar (triggers browser voice permission prompt).
Do NOT click the top-left hamburger menu to search.
Use press_key('k') instead of 'space' to play/pause so the page does not accidentally scroll down when the player isn't focused.
Do NOT spawn browse_web to inspect a channel or search result — stay in the active desktop YouTube window and click the channel or video directly via smart_click.

open_channel_or_video.primary: smart_click('channel avatar or name in search results')
open_channel_or_video.verify: The channel home page or video loads in the current tab

search.verify: YouTube search results feed loads for the query

play_pause.visual_fallback: smart_click('Play or Pause button at bottom-left of video player')
play_pause.verify: Video playback toggles between playing and paused

fullscreen.visual_fallback: smart_click('Full screen button at bottom-right of video player')
fullscreen.verify: Video player enters or exits fullscreen

mute.visual_fallback: smart_click('Mute speaker icon at bottom-left of video player')

toggle_captions.visual_fallback: smart_click('Subtitles/closed captions CC button on video player bar')
toggle_captions.verify: Closed captions toggle on or off

next_video.visual_fallback: smart_click('Next video button next to Play on player bar')
next_video.verify: Navigates to the next video in playlist or Up Next

dismiss_popups.primary: smart_click('Skip or Skip Ads or No thanks or Reject all or Accept all button')
dismiss_popups.verify: Ad overlay or consent/premium prompt is dismissed
